items.title: Close two gaps in the skill link contract, and fix what they surface …
items.description:
Close two gaps in the skill link contract, and fix what they surface (#258)

link_problems now scans assets/*.md and matches bare command-position paths (python scripts/x.py) inside fenced blocks, and the meta suite applies the document rules to doc-only skills as well as script-bearing ones. Fixes the eight broken references this surfaced in nextflow, research-grants, scientific-critical-thinking and scientific-slides, with version bumps for each.

items.title: statsmodels skill: fix invalid causal inference example, use real Tre…
items.description:
statsmodels skill: fix invalid causal inference example, use real TreatmentEffect API (#250)

statsmodels.treatment.propensity_score does not exist and the old example mislabelled a logistic fit as matching. Replace it with statsmodels.treatment.treatment_effects.TreatmentEffect (IPW, RA, AIPW), keep propensity estimation as a separate diagnostic snippet, add causal caveats (effect_group, OLS-only outcome, params[-6:] shape error and return_results=False), and bump to 1.3.
items.label: commit

items.description:
fix(database-lookup): retire dead PatentsView search API for ODP (#245)

search.patentsview.org is NXDOMAIN after USPTO's 2026-03-20 Open Data Portal migration. Rewrite the PatentsView section around the ODP transition guide and bulk datasets, swap credentials to USPTO_ODP_API_KEY, note the pause in the selection guide, and replace the 404 ClinicalTrials AllAPIJSON.zip with the working AllPublicXML.zip path.

items.title: fix(simpy): report a non-UTF-8 resource CSV as unreadable, not as a b…
items.description:
fix(simpy): report a non-UTF-8 resource CSV as unreadable, not as a bad integer (#259)

UnicodeError is a ValueError subclass, so the 'invalid integer' handler was catching decode failures first. Swap the two except clauses so a non-UTF-8 CSV is reported as unreadable.

Add DataLad skill for dataset retrieval and computational provenance (#227)

New datalad skill covering dataset discovery and on-demand retrieval over git-annex, computational provenance with datalad run / rerun / containers-run, and publishing with special remotes and RIA stores. Reviewed upstream by the DataLad maintainers; registered in README.md and docs/skills.md (163 -> 164 skills).
